items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 22 June 2026 at 9:55pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the British Isles.


##Wind##

Variable or Southeast 2 to 4, occasionally touching 5 in the east of the area, becoming Variable 3 or less in all waters tomorrow afternoon, then Variable or Northerly 2 to 4 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Showers in the east of the area, possibly turning thundery for a time overnight, soon becoming mainly fair, but with a risk of mist patches developing tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in any showers or mist patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Variable or Northerly 2 to 4.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
